contract_deviations: A9 follow_ups DELETE: a non-owner may delete own plain notes only when done_by IS NULL as well as due_on IS NULL. Plain notes are always inserted with done_by NULL (A9 insert pin) and done_by is not in the web UPDATE grant, so this only stops a ticked reminder whose date was cleared by UPDATE (due_on is in the grant) from becoming deletable.
A9 follow_ups INSERT: the pending branch also requires done_at IS NULL (the SEC2-05 fix text); every app path and definer already inserts pending reminders with done_at NULL.
open_issues: Hosted readiness (security sign-off): with a function owner that does NOT bypass RLS, fn_quote_send fails on the quotations UPDATE policy (42501) and the 0006 function-only tables (orders, payments, dispatches have SELECT policies only) would refuse writes too. The 0005/0006 definers therefore require an RLS-bypassing owner on hosted Supabase (expected: the postgres role has BYPASSRLS there; confirm with SELECT rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user on the hosted DB). The A9 follow_ups checks themselves pass under RLS (fn_sample_set_status proof).
